answer_1.quote: We suggest breaking down the long-term goal into three progressively challenging stages: basic visual facts description (L1), plot narration (L2), and applicable AD text generation (L3).
answer_1.outputs: movie narrations describing visual content and plot for visually impaired audiences

answer_2.quote: We also report performance on BLEU, METEOR, CIDEr, and BERTScore for further reference.

answer_3.quote: We propose a new evaluation framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to separately assess narrative quality from the L1 and L2 perspectives.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to validate the effectiveness of our proposed L1/L2 metrics. A random sample of 300 videos is selected, each accompanied by narrations generated by two distinct models. Three human annotators independently rank each pair of narrations, indicating which is better or if they are comparable.
answer_4.guideline: Three human annotators independently rank each pair of narrations, indicating which is better or if they are comparable.
